verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the edges of compliance operations. Account locking blocks activity during an investigation or remediation, and KYC/KYB runs through a bank-approved third-party vendor, which hints at a fintech/bank split of responsibility. Nothing documents transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, alert case management or SAR filing. Missing for 10: transaction monitoring tooling, sanctions/OFAC screening, alert case management, SAR-filing support, an explicit division of compliance duties between fintech, platform and bank, independent corroboration.
